difficulty_reason: The lemma collects seven consequences of the assumption that a morphism of schemes is universally injective and integral (statement lines 6204-6241, a statement with seven numbered clauses). The proof is a complete chain of named inputs: the companion results of the same chapter give properties (A), (B) and (C) together with almost cocontinuity of the base change functor (proof lines 6243-6251); the implications from those properties give the first three clauses (proof lines 6251-6260); and the remaining clauses, concerning surjectivity of the unit, faithfulness and exactness, follow formally through the general exactness results for morphisms of sites (proof lines 6260-6266). The non-formal content is the assembly of the seven clauses out of these inputs, each of which the author names. The claim is H2: one structured reduction, every step attributed.
